title: Isolate release self-test local app data
summary: Give each Windows release-verification job an isolated writable LOCALAPPDATA root under the assigned runner temporary directory.
reason: Hosted runners do not guarantee that LOCALAPPDATA\MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO exists, while release self-test and package verification correctly require a writable configuration parent.
behavior_before: Release self-test and package verification inherited the hosted runner LOCALAPPDATA path and failed when its MediaPipeline configuration parent had not been created.
behavior_after: Only release self-test and package verification jobs create and use an isolated LOCALAPPDATA root under RUNNER_TEMP before running the required release gates.
manual_validation: RED: the strengthened audit-spine guard failed because neither release-self-test nor package-verify job prepared an isolated LOCALAPPDATA parent.
GREEN: the audit-spine guard and YAML parsing for both workflow files passed after adding job-scoped setup for release self-tests and package verification.
The full release self-test will run with the same isolated LOCALAPPDATA shape before this packet is marked complete.
rollback_plan: Remove the isolated LOCALAPPDATA setup from release-self-test and package-verify jobs and rerun the audit spine and release self-test only if the project's supported configuration validation behavior changes.
notes:
Add an audit-spine regression guard before editing either workflow.
Keep the configuration override scoped to release-verification jobs so other CI jobs retain their existing environment behavior.
Create a release-self-test-scoped LOCALAPPDATA parent under RUNNER_TEMP.
Guard each release-self-test and package-verify job for the isolated LOCALAPPDATA setup.
Create an isolated LOCALAPPDATA parent for package verification because build -Verify invokes the release self-test.
Refresh the generated-drift workflow summary after adding release-test local app data isolation.
Refresh the audit-spine summary after guarding release-test local app data isolation.
Record the generated summary for the release-test local app data packet.
